emails.subject: Security notice for services using Ghostscript or ImageMagick
emails.snippet: A remote-code-execution vulnerability (Upload2Shell, CVE-2026-125396) affects Render services using Ghostscript, ImageMagick, or Pillow — redeploy or update if any of yours do.
emails.reason: Real RCE vulnerability affecting your Render-hosted services if any use Ghostscript/ImageMagick/Pillow — worth checking which of your deployments are exposed.
